descriptions.text: 100,000 Gold Coin Casino Chip. This is a comp chip, and it may not be sold or transferred. You may not redeem this chip directly for gold. This chip must be played at the High Roller's Roulette Table or the Wheel of Fortune game at the Desperado Club Casino. Good luck.

beats.headline: Not a lottery ticket
beats.text: Carl expected another lottery ticket from his Lucky Bastard box, the one he got for surviving Signet's attack, and instead gets a single casino chip. Mordecai snatches it before it can vanish into Carl's inventory; he has never even seen one. It is black, with pink and purple splotches staggered round the edge and a familiar dagger logo in the centre, and it feels as if it weighs fifteen pounds. So you're rich, Mordecai says. Maybe. It can only be played at the High Roller's Roulette Table or the Wheel of Fortune. Bea always loved roulette.

beats.headline: One spin, then another
beats.text: Carl wants to cash the chip in. It is the Wheel of Fortune or waiting until the sixth floor for the High Rollers Roulette Table, and he never liked roulette anyway. The croupier, Tito, explains that a comp chip is the maximum bet and leaves only two red spots on the wheel: Nothing! and Get stabbed in the stomach by the croupier. Carl does the odds and plunks it down. The wheel stops on Spin Again, beside the 500,000-gold sliver. Behind him a roulette player drops through the floor into the Nothing. The needle hangs by Nothing! and settles on green: a Scroll of Upgrade.
